payload.text: Issue 0650, S, on vc's order of 2026-11-10: the upgrade that writes the tracked hook dispatchers keeps a marked export-ignore block in the project's .gitattributes, rewritten in place when present, appended when absent, and written nowhere a line of the project's own already decides export-ignore for the hooks directory; doctor's default root-file-behind line names a .gitattributes that lacks the block and decides nothing; Intent's own .gitattributes takes the block. Worktree tmp/wt-ic-0650 at base 1fe4a4bec. fix-v1's run (desk 01M732QB6A0531N5TTQ6WW2F1Z, 15:55:31Z to 15:58:01Z) was red at the base as intended and green but for ic's own doctor arm, whose Advisory finding a default doctor hides and which repeated root-file-behind; reading it found that the upgrade appended its block after a project's own opt-out and overturned it. fix-v2 is banked at refs/bank/ic/0650/fix-v2-on-1fe4a4bec (blob a8a3de1da063, patch_id 5bef374fa083, 9 files, +440 -4): gitstate::export_ignore_decided, no block where the project decided, doctor.rs back at the base, and the arm drives all three. Next: its run, asked as 01M73314CQ77HXA2DD7H0HHGM0 behind the Utilz release run that holds every heavy lane, then report to vc.
